SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id AS memberId, md.name AS name, md.email AS email FROM members m JOIN member_details md ON m.member_id = md.member_id WHERE m.status = 0 AND m.member_id NOT IN ( SELECT member_id FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} )
AND ( md.name LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%' OR md.email LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%' )
SELECT md.name AS name, md.email AS email FROM member_details md WHERE md.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT invite_key AS inviteKey, workspace_id AS workspaceId, inviter_id AS inviterId, accepted_member_id AS acceptedMemberId, email, name, status, TO_CHAR(expires, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS expires, TO_CHAR(accepted, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS accepted, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, invite_status AS inviteStatus FROM workspace_invites WHERE invite_key = #{inviteKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_invites SET accepted_member_id = #{acceptedMemberId}, accepted = SYSDATE, invite_status = #{inviteStatus} WHERE invite_key = #{inviteKey} AND invite_status = 0 AND status = 0 AND expires > SYSDATE
